name: theorem1_check
theory: Chen & Yeh 2026, 'How Much Should GPTQ Damp?', Theorem 1
split: tuning split only (rows P..P+tune-1); test / confirmation splits never touched
sigma: S per (layer, expert, group) = X^T X / n_tune in fp64, unweighted, X = the expert's tuning activations from prep_tune(tune_holdout(model, L, cache, sp['tune']), L, e) (first 128 routed tokens per sequence, the rows tune_err_groups uses)
hessian: H_hat = running sum of low_data_diag.hessians over nested_order(pool, seed) prefixes (exactly damping_threshold.py), fp32 accumulator cast to fp64; dead-column fix and act-order perm replicated from gptq.py (perm taken from info['perm'] whenever the solver was run)

metrics.R_ideal: tr(M^T S M) / tr(S), computed as sum(M * (S @ M)) in fp64, M = (diag(U)^-1 U)^T, U = upper chol(cholesky_inverse(chol(H_hat + nu*mean(diag) I)))
metrics.R_w: sum over projections of the group of sum_t col_err2_t * m_t^T S m_t
metrics.e_meas: sum over projections of the group of sum_r u_r^T S u_r, u = W(dead cols zeroed as in the solver) - Q; e_true (unfixed W) also recorded
metrics.clamp_frac: fraction of weights whose round(w/scale + zero) falls outside [0, 15] on the fitted grid (info scale/zero): clamp_frac_W uses the original W; clamp_frac_work uses the working weights Q + Delta with Delta = M^-1 u
metrics.measured_ratio: tune_err_groups(W, Q_gptq, T)[g] / tune_err_groups(W, Q_rtn, T)[g] (existing metric)
metrics.cholesky_failure: cell recorded as failed; no jitter ever added

B1.experts: all 60 (fallback to 24 if > 6 GPU-hours estimated: B2's 12 + ranks [9, 10, 19, 20, 39, 40, 49, 50, 14, 15, 44, 45])

B2.experts: 12 per layer: sort experts by seed-0 B32 routed tokens ascending, ties to the lower id, take ranks [0, 1], [29, 30], [58, 59]

part_B.reproducibility: on the first layer processed, recomputed tune_err_groups for the B2 experts must match runs_diag/damping_threshold_raw.jsonl (per group, nu in its grid) and runs_diag/damping_selection_raw.jsonl ('all', nu in {0.01,0.03,0.05,0.1}) to <= 1e-6 relative; abort otherwise

part_C.seed1: only if the time estimate allows (decided after seed 0, recorded)
part_C.experts: per layer the experts at ranks 0, 29, 59 of seed-0 B32 routed tokens (ascending, ties to lower id)
part_C.data: per-sequence routed activations (all routed tokens, model dtype, selected experts only) over the seed's 256 nested_order calibration ids
part_C.invariant: H_hat from these activations for the prefix-32 ids equals low_data_diag.hessians up to a scalar (relative Frobenius diff <= 1e-5 after trace normalization), identical token counts; asserted for 3 experts x 2 groups per layer
part_C.subsets: random subsets of whole sequences drawn without replacement from the 256 ids; for group g and target rho in [0.15, 0.25, 0.35, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.45, 1.6, 2.0, 2.5, 3.5, 5.0], k = clip(round(rho * d_g / mean tokens per sequence), 1, 256); 5 draws per size via random.Random(SWEEP_SALT + seed*1e6 + layer*1e4 + expert*10 + group_index).sample; if k == 256 only one draw (all draws identical); realized n recorded
part_C.nu_star: argmin of R_ideal over nu_fine, refined by the vertex of a parabola in log nu through the 3 points around the argmin, R_ideal evaluated at the refined value; edge argmin flagged, not refined

report.T1: per group (gu, down), cell = (seed, layer, n, expert) of B1 with at least one tuning sequence: Spearman over the nu grid between R_ideal(nu) and the measured GPTQ/RTN tune_err_groups ratio; argmin agreement = |index(argmin R_ideal) - index(argmin measured)| <= 1 on the grid. PRIMARY grid = the 10 nu values measured for all 60 experts in runs_diag/damping_threshold_raw.jsonl (0.03 and 0.05 have no per-group measurement there); SECONDARY = full 12-nu grid on B2 cells (measured here). Summaries by group x prefix.

verdict.per_group_pass: frac argmin agreement >= 0.70 AND median Spearman >= 0.8 (primary T1)

report.T2: B2 medians / IQRs of gap_R1 and gap_R2 by group x nu, and clamp fractions (descriptive)
report.T3: R_ideal at nu=0.01 binned by tokens/d_in with damping_threshold.RATIO_BINS (min 20 points per bin as in the original), side by side with the observed ratios of damping_threshold_report.md section 2; Part C per-expert peak n/d of R_ideal(0.01) (median, IQR) with down anchors overlaid (descriptive)
report.T4: Part C nu* vs n/d with nu_GS and adaptive_damping.md per-budget optima; OLS fit log nu* = a + b log(d/n) separately for n<d and n>d over refined interior nu*, 95% CI of b by bootstrap over experts (2000 resamples, seed 0) (descriptive)

constraints: fp64 for S, H_hat, M, R
no edits to moe_calib/gptq.py, configs/frozen_b4.json or existing runs
no caching of full-layer activations for all experts x 256 sequences
